title: Pocket Todo
delivery: Local single-user todo app with lists, SQLite persistence and a responsive browser UI, exported to a new folder

requirements.description: Inbox always exists; create, rename, and delete lists with validation and unique names; Inbox is protected
Add, complete, and delete todos in a list, with validation and All/Active/Done filtering
Deleting a list deletes its todos; data survives a server restart
Served page has labelled controls, list picker, filters, status region and local assets
In a real browser at phone and laptop widths the user can switch lists, add, complete, filter, and manage lists

jobs.goal: Implement server.py exactly as in architecture.md: launch flags, READY line, SQLite schema with Inbox, the lists and todos API, and static file serving for index.html, app.js, styles.css (which may be absent at this stage).
Build the browser UI in index.html, styles.css and app.js following design.md and design.json (direction B, list picker) against the approved API. Use the exact element ids and labels in design.md.
